title: Implement cook mode session shell and gather phase
description: Create `CookModeView` with session-scoped state, internal scale locking via `Recipe.scaled(by:)`, idle-timer lifecycle handling, dismiss affordance, and the initial gather-ingredients screen that resets on each entry.
acceptance_criteria: `CookModeView` owns cook-session state for phase, gathered ingredients, and locked scale.
The first rendered phase is the ingredient checklist with a close affordance and a `Start cooking` CTA.
Ingredient checklist state is session-local and does not block advancing to the step phase.
`UIApplication.shared.isIdleTimerDisabled` is enabled while cook mode is visible and restored on dismissal.

handoff_summary.completed: Replaced the CookModeView stub with a full implementation: private CookPhase enum (.gatherIngredients / .steps), @State phase and scaledRecipe (locked at session entry via recipe.scaled(by: scale.factor)), idle-timer management via onAppear/onDisappear, NavigationStack with Close toolbar button, and GatherIngredientsPhase (private struct) showing CookModeIngredientList in checklist mode with an unconditional "Start cooking" CTA. CookModeIngredientList.swift required no changes — already complete from prior bead.
handoff_summary.remaining: The .steps CookPhase case is a ContentUnavailableView placeholder. A follow-up bead must implement the full step-by-step navigator view.
handoff_summary.risks: Idle-timer restoration relies on onDisappear; app-backgrounding mid-session may still let the screen dim in unusual edge cases. The .steps placeholder must be replaced before the feature ships — leaving it too long risks it being forgotten.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify idle-timer enable/disable, gather checklist resets on each new fullScreenCover presentation, and that Start cooking advances phase regardless of check state. Then the step-navigator bead should implement CookPhase.steps.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — CookModeView.swift and CookModeIngredientList.swift are exclusive to this feature branch. RecipeDetailSheet.swift is unchanged and continues to pass recipe + scale to CookModeView correctly.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Scale locked at session entry via recipe.scaled(by: scale.factor) stored in @State scaledRecipe; CookModeIngredientList receives scale: .one to avoid double-scaling pre-scaled quantities. GatherIngredientsPhase is a private struct within CookModeView.swift rather than a separate file to keep the file count minimal at this stage. metadata.title used for navigation title (not metadata.name which does not exist on Metadata). ContentUnavailableView used for .steps placeholder — communicates intent clearly without being a real implementation.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (developer bead). Tester bead should cover: (1) idle timer state transitions, (2) checklist resets across separate fullScreenCover presentations, (3) Start cooking advances to .steps regardless of checked count.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: UIApplication.shared.isIdleTimerDisabled is not restored to its prior value — it is unconditionally set to false on dismiss. For this personal-use app this is acceptable, but would need refinement in a multi-consumer setting.

conflict_risks: None — CookModeView.swift and CookModeIngredientList.swift are exclusive to this feature branch. RecipeDetailSheet.swift is unchanged and continues to pass recipe + scale to CookModeView correctly.

execution_history.summary: Implemented CookModeView with session-scoped state, scale locking, idle-timer lifecycle, dismiss affordance, and the gather-ingredients phase. Build is clean.

- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
